title: Display all relationships when showing an issue
description:
Update 'show' command to display both incoming and outgoing relationships. When showing issue B that is the target of relationships from other issues (e.g., A part_of B), display those incoming relationships clearly.

Changes needed:
1. Update show command to query all issues and find incoming relationships
2. Update summary command to include relationship statistics
3. Update list --tree to show relationship counts
4. Clarify relationship direction in display output
5. Update epic command similarly
6. Note: next command unchanged for now
7. This works with current unidirectional storage by querying all issues
8. Update tests and examples
